title: Kanda 3: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 3.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 3.

verses.original: सहृदयं सांमनस्यमविद्वेषं कृणोमि वः । अन्यो अन्यमभि हर्यत वत्सं जातमिवाघ्न्या ॥
verses.transliteration: sahṛdayaṁ sāṁmanasyamavidveṣaṁ kṛṇomi vaḥ | anyo anyamabhi haryata vatsaṁ jātamivāghnyā ||
verses.translation: I make you of one heart, of one mind, free from all enmity and hatred! Love one another tenderly, even as the cow loveth the newborn calf!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The supreme Vedic hymn of concord (Sammanasya Sukta): establishing unconditional love and harmony in family and community.

layers.author: whitney
